name: Kosovo
statusNote: Kosovo declared independence from Serbia in 2008. Its recognition is not universal, and Serbia contests its independence.

name: Western Sahara
statusNote: Western Sahara is listed by the United Nations as a Non-Self-Governing Territory. Its final status is unresolved; Morocco and the Polisario Front contest sovereignty. The flag shown is the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic (SADR) flag.
flagDescription: Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic flag associated with Western Sahara
